note: The nine roles of the ux-spec (bg, fg, hi, dim, faint, acc, ok, err, sel) plus shade, which the mocks use for covered or frozen content. Each role has its ANSI slot (theme-following default), the opt-in truecolor 'Classical' values and the ansi16 values the HTML preview paints for its 16-colour mocks, in dark and light. Bold and underline are separate from the role: screens/ marks them with **x** and __x__.
detect: Query the terminal background (OSC 11), fall back to COLORFGBG, then to dark. Respect NO_COLOR.

shade.use: content behind an overlay, and the frozen body while offline
shade.ansi: not named in the ux-spec (spec.md, Open questions)

noColor.rule: Under NO_COLOR every role is the terminal's default foreground and sel equals bg, so only the ▌ focus bar marks the focused row. Bold and underline stay. Every state still reads through glyphs (▌ ○ ✗ ━ ┄) and words.

markup.underline: __text__, inside a role; drawn in acc (room tab, stream filter, reader tab, Retro period, link, palette match)
markup.buttons: ⟦ key Label ⟧. [acc]⟦[/] … [acc]⟧[/] is the primary button (acc border), [faint]⟦[/] … [faint]⟧[/] the others (faint border)
markup.rules: an unmarked │ or full-width ─ rule is faint; a box carries its border role on every border cell
